items: Our work is handled by our own team. We do not further outsource or engage freelance teams to execute client requirements.

Our teams bring domain knowledge across creative, digital, post-production, publishing, and business applications that allows us to understand your requirements, engage and provide tailored solutions.
We provide an array of services under Creative service that includes Graphic design, Digital, Post production support, Animation, Publishing and many more all under one roof.
We act as a one stop solution for all creative and design support for our clients. This saves time of coordinating multiple vendors for similar tasks or workflows.

Your requirement may start with one project or a small team, however as your business grows and there is a dire need to scale, you need to look no further. We can scale-up in short notice with relevant skill sets, which will ensure you continue to grow your business.
Our QA process coupled with tailored resources, project management, and well defined workflows help maintain consistency across ongoing engagements.

items.name: DataNote
items.tag: ERP, CRM & POS in One Business Platform
items.text: DataNote brings core business functions together through ERP, CRM, and POS capabilities. It supports areas including inventory, sales, customer engagement, production, procurement, logistics, HR, and administration, helping businesses connect information and manage operations more effectively.
features: Connects inventory, production, procurement, logistics, HR and administration so operations run from one system.
Keeps sales and customer engagement together, so every conversation and follow-up lives in one place.
Handles point-of-sale alongside the rest of your business data, so sales feed straight into inventory and reporting.
Access key business information and tasks from your mobile device, wherever your team works.

items.name: Formezy
items.text: Formezy is designed to help businesses create and manage processes more efficiently, bringing form building, data analytics, and integrations together in a user-friendly environment. Its applications extend across areas such as procurement, CRM, production, inventory, and quality control.

items.name: Docezy
items.text: Docezy helps businesses organize, store, and share files through a secure, user-friendly platform. It combines fast uploads and downloads, collaboration, powerful search and retrieval, and security features to make document management easier to handle.

items.title: Discovery
items.text: We review your requirements, in line with your business objective, target audience, existing workflow, and expected outcome.

items.title: Scope
items.text: We define the scope of work, determine the right approach, capabilities, resources, technology, and delivery structure.

items.title: Kick-off
items.text: We identify the right skill set within our team and provide specific training to ensure that we deliver consistent output as per the agreed SLA’s. The kick-off meeting helps us to align with timelines and quality expectations. We formulate our internal QC document to ensure every project passes through stringent QC before it reaches you.

items.title: Scale
items.text: As your business grows and you have a need to scale the operations we will ensure that the right resources are in place that cater to your growing needs. Additionally we have tailored our engagement models that are suited to your needs.

items.title: Execute
items.text: Our team continues to work as per the defined workflow. The project management team will ensure that projects are delivered as per SLA.
